description: CommonRoad Scenario Designer is a Python toolbox maintained by the CommonRoad project for preparing autonomous-driving maps and scenarios. It converts OpenDRIVE, Lanelet/Lanelet2, OpenStreetMap and SUMO maps to CommonRoad and supports reverse conversion for several formats. A GUI and command-line interface allow scenario editing, map verification and repair, while Python APIs support scripted preparation. Outputs are converted map/scenario files and optional visualisations. Geographic coverage and road detail follow user inputs; the package has no fixed observation period or surveyed network. Public source and PyPI installation are free under GPL-3.0. The README documents Linux and Python 3.10–3.13 and labels the release beta. A material limitation is that missing OSM lane geometry is estimated and often needs manual correction. Conversion success therefore does not establish map fidelity. The resource supports reproducible road-scenario preparation and connects with SUMO (model-sumo). The 2021 toolbox paper and 2023 formal-map-verification paper describe its methods. This review did not convert maps or independently test verification guarantees.
